title: Abort-retry and bind-retry previews omit when automatic recovery ends under an enforced admission budget
outcome: While a retry is scheduled for a head whose 240-second admission budget is enforced, every retry preview names the wait, the attempt, the next time and when automatic recovery ends, as docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md says. Today only engram_admission_retry_preview appends engram_admission_budget_preview_suffix. The acknowledged preview of a BeginPreparation abort retry ("delivery not attempted; retrying automatically at …", src/engram_abort_retry.rs ~:291) and the bind-retry previews do not. Either add the suffix (and the attempt) to those previews, with a test, or narrow the doc sentence.
acceptance: Abort-retry and bind-retry previews omit when automatic recovery ends under an enforced admission budget is done
